}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== Beagleboard logo, and "BeagleY-AI Rev A" are silkscreened on board top. {{See also|BeagleBoard Devices|List of SBCs}}
Device PCIe connector, RTC battery, UART, fan connector and PoE :connector are compatible with [[RPF_Raspberry_Pi_5_8GB]] accessories.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Texas Instruments]] AM67A @1.4GHz :SoC: Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A53) :MCU: ARM (Cortex-R5) @800MHz :DSP/AI:Dual general-purpose C7x DSP w/MMA 4 TOPS *GPU: [[Imagination]] BXS-4-64 :OpenGL ES 3.2, Vulkan 1.2, :H.265 (HEVC) (up to 4Kp60 decode), :H.264 (up to 1080p60 decode, 1080p30 encode) *Storage: TF card (max.512GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4) SDRAM *Wi-Fi: [[Texas Instruments]] CC3301 (1T1R) :SDIO: Wi-Fi 6 2.4GHz 802.11ax, UART/PCM: BT 5.4 LE *Network: 1x 1GbE port *USB: 4x USB 3.0 (Host), 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) OTG ports *PCIe: PCIe (Gen3) x1 via ribbon cable *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port or optional PoE Hat
